_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes: Simulator tolerates brief buffered NI delivery with a two-second warning and fifteen-second grace. Persistent stalls stop and vent the cuff, preserve aborted files, restart the same NI task after verified IDLE, and retry exact settings after fresh acquisition and thirty seconds vented. Retries are bounded. Success requires native data through protocol completion without clock gaps or backtracks. Arduino protections, PID, calibration and presets remain unchanged. Original trial IDs remain stable in results CSVs. 154 focused tests passed per branch; layout and GUI smoke passed. NI pause root cause remains unproven.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
